findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe os.open usage in filelock
 * @description Inspect os.open calls and their flags/mode arguments for symlink-following or truncation risks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/filelock/os-open-inspect
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-367
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string flags, string mode
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall() and
  flags = call.getArg(1).toString() and
  mode = call.getArg(2).toString()
select call, "os.open call with flags=$@ and mode=$@", call.getArg(1), flags, call.getArg(2), mode
findings.hypothesis: os.open calls may follow symlinks (O_TRUNC without O_NOFOLLOW) or use insecure permission modes

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Destructive file operations in filelock
 * @description Finds calls to file deletion/rename/replacement functions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/filelock/destructive-ops
 * @tags security
 */

import python

from Call call, string name
where
  call.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() = name and
  name in ["unlink", "remove", "rmdir", "rename", "replace", "rmtree", "chmod", "chown", "symlink"]
select call, "Destructive/metadata file operation: " + name
findings.hypothesis: Detect file deletion, rename, permission change, or symlink creation operations
